ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution. Approximately 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated at the base and margins, and 45% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated in the central and upper regions of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive irregular white mottling across the medial and distal regions of both lobes. Large contiguous white blob on the upper-right lobe interrupted by dark linear streaks. Mirror-like mottled distribution on the left lobe with a higher density of dark focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees; notch apex is sharp and well-defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge. Prominent jagged peaks observed, particularly on the outer third of the left lobe and the mid-section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the distal margins, tapering to sharp lateral tips. Symmetrical upward sweep from the peduncle transition.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of high-intensity circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) located on the extreme lateral tip of the left lobe. Smaller, scattered circular white spots visible on the lower-mid left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent, parallel dark diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) on the upper-right lobe. Multiple fine, multi-directional scratches visible within the white mottled region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy scarring and presence of sessile barnacles on the left lobe tip. Significant rake mark trauma visible on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Solid dark pigmentation 'island' surrounded by white mottling in the mid-region of the left lobe.
